after_midnight.description: True when the row continues the previous evening's service of its day code past midnight (see note).

category.description: Service category as in the file (e.g. "ALIMENTADOR", "LIGEIRÃO"; accents and case ignored). Call with no arguments to get the list.

skipped_rows.description: Rows of the file left out because they did not match the expected shape (also stated in `note`).

line_code.description: Only stops this line serves (code as in bus_lines_search; case ignored).

skipped_rows.description: Rows of the file left out because they did not match the expected shape (also stated in `note`).

lines.description: Lines and directions serving the stop; null when `source` is geocuritiba_layer (it has no lines per stop).

topic.description: holidays (default): municipal administration holidays and closures of 2026; school: municipal school calendars 2026; iptu: IPTU 2026 general rule.

unit.description: school only: escolas, cmeis or cmaees; all three when omitted.

date.description: school only: YYYY-MM-DD; says whether it is a school day.

expired.description: True after 2026-12-31 (Curitiba time): the values are of 2026 only.

to.description: Same as `from` for a single day.

kind.description: national_holiday, municipal_holiday (religious, municipal law), optional_day (ponto facultativo), no_office (suspensão do expediente), no_office_until_14h, recess.

expired.description: True after 2026-12-31 (Curitiba time): the values are of 2026 only.

name.description: Holiday name as printed; null for other kinds.

school_days_per_month.description: Dias letivos per month, January first, as printed.

school_day.description: Null when the date is not in 2026.

expired.description: True after 2026-12-31 (Curitiba time): the values are of 2026 only.

secondary_source.description: Legisweb notes mirroring Prefeitura releases, not the Prefeitura itself.

type.description: Facility type in Portuguese, accents and case ignored: e.g. "feira", "rua da cidadania", "ecoponto", "biblioteca", "farol do saber", "centro cultural", "cinema", "academia ao ar livre", "velodromo", "banheiro publico", "parque", "estacao ecologica", "ciclovia". "list types" (or "tipos") returns every accepted type and makes no network call.

bairro.description: Neighbourhood name as published (e.g. "Capão Raso"); accents and case ignored, whole name.

name.description: Keep only records whose name contains every word of this text (accents and case ignored); never sent.

near.description: Keep only facilities within `radius_m` of this position (decimal degrees), nearest first.

radius_m.description: With `near` only: search radius in metres (default 1000, at most 3000).

skipped_records.description: Records of the layer left out: no name, or a bike lane not operational.

kind.description: Park or bike-lane kind as published; null for other facilities.

hours.description: Days, hours and notes as published (observacao), one line each.

open_periods.description: Which periods the facility works in (func_manha, func_tarde, func_noite, func_24hr); null when not published.

phones.description: Institutional landlines and service numbers only; mobiles are dropped.

emails.description: Addresses at curitiba.pr.gov.br only; any other domain is dropped.

updated.description: When IPPUC last updated the record (dt_atualiz), YYYY-MM-DD.

sections.description: Voting places only: número de seções as published; null for other types.

electoral_zone.description: Voting places only: zona eleitoral as published, e.g. "1ª"; null for other types.

distance_m.description: Straight-line distance from `near`, in metres; null without `near`.

types.description: Only for "list types": every accepted type.

checked_at.description: When the server read the layer (it is cached for up to 6 hours).

category.description: One category id; call with no arguments to list them with counts.

name.description: Words to find in the name; accents, case and punctuation are ignored, every word must match.

near.description: Only points within radius_m of this position, nearest first, with distance_m.

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres around near (default 1500, at most 10000).

skipped_rows.description: Rows of the file left out because they did not match the expected shape (also stated in `note`).

open_step.description: Ask the user's client to confirm opening this step's link (URL-mode elicitation); else returns the link.

query.description: Words to find in the service title or summary; accents, case and punctuation are ignored, every word must match.

category.description: Exact category name. Call with no arguments to get the list.

online_only.description: true: only services with an online link.

page.description: Page of the file list (50 files per page, newest first).

topic.description: licensing_calendar: annual licensing due dates and fee; units: Detran-PR units in Curitiba and nearby.

plate_final.description: Last digit of the plate (0-9), only for licensing_calendar. Omit to get all ten dates.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 7 days after 'from'.

text.description: Words to find in the title, place, address or category; accents and case are ignored, every word must match.

category.description: Category as published (accents and case ignored).

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days after 'from'.

text.description: Words to find in the title; accents and case ignored, every word must match. Never sent to the source.

city.description: City as published, whole name, accents and case ignored (default "Curitiba"); "all" keeps every city.

other_city_rows.description: Rows in the date range left out because of `city`.

truncated.description: The calendar had more pages than this server reads; later events are missing.

partial.description: Deprecated alias of `truncated` (always equal; kept for compatibility, may be removed in a later version): true only when listing pages are missing. The listing (title, dates, city, link) is the complete answer; missing event-page details are in details_pending.

details_pending.description: Items on this page whose event page was not read yet (details: "not_read") or failed in this call (a removed page is not counted): venue, age rating and price are an optional enrichment, filled by later calls.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, Curitiba local time, as listed.

end.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, Curitiba local time, as listed.

venue.description: From the event page ("Local:"); null when not read or not found.

age_rating.description: "Livre" or "N anos" from the event page; null when not read or not found.

price.description: Ticket prices as published on the event page; null when not read or not in a known shape.

details.description: Whether the event page was read for venue, age rating and price.

checked_at.description: When the server read the calendar (it is cached for up to 1 hour).

name.description: Text in the unit name, accents and case ignored (e.g. 'UMS', 'CAPS').

unit_type.description: CNES unit type: a numeric code or text in its label (e.g. 'unidade basica', 'pronto atendimento', '2').

page.description: Upstream page to start scanning from; pass the previous result's next_page to continue.

skip.description: Matches to skip on the first scanned page; pass the previous result's next_skip to continue.

discarded.description: Records dropped as non-public or incomplete on the pages this call scanned (a page resumed with skip is not counted again); a sudden jump can mean a format change.

file.description: CSV file name (or relative path) inside the folder set by CURITIBAI_DATA_DIR.

group_by.description: Column to count rows by (exact name; accents and case ignored). Not with filter_column.

top.description: How many of the largest groups to return.

filter_column.description: Count only rows where this column equals filter_value. Not with group_by.

near.description: The position to search around, in decimal degrees.

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres (default 400, at most 1000).

at.description: Start of the window, HH:MM (default: now in Curitiba, America/Sao_Paulo). Before 04:00 with `day` inferred, the previous evening's after-midnight trips are read too.

day.description: URBS day code: "1" weekday, "2" Saturday, "3" Sunday or holiday (inferred reading). Default: from today's weekday in Curitiba. Holidays are not detected: on one, pass the code URBS announces. When given, it is read as the service day: its own after-midnight trips are included, the next day's early trips are not.

window_min.description: Minutes after `at` to look ahead (default 60, at most 180).

line_code.description: Only this line (code as in bus_lines_search; case ignored).

day_inferred.description: True when `day` came from today's weekday, not from the input.

after_midnight.description: True: this part reads only the rows that continue that code's evening past midnight; false: only the others.

windows.description: The (day code, time range, after-midnight rows or not) parts searched: several around midnight.

cut_at_midnight.description: True when the window passes 24:00 but `day` was given: that day's after-midnight trips are read, the next calendar day's early-morning trips are not (see note).

stops_considered.description: Stops with coordinates within radius_m (any line).

stops_with_times.description: Of those, stops the timetable lists at any day and time (for line_code, when given).

skipped_rows.description: Rows of the file left out because they did not match the expected shape (also stated in `note`).

after_midnight.description: True when the trip continues the previous evening's service of its day code past midnight (see note).

query.description: Search term in Portuguese. When it finds nothing, the search is retried once without accents and then with a short list of synonyms (e.g. 'ônibus' → 'transporte coletivo').

note.description: Present when the query was retried (which query matched, or every query tried) or when a later request was refused with HTTP 429 (how long to wait).

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, inside Curitiba (-25.7 to -25.3).

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, inside Curitiba (-49.45 to -49.15).

include.description: Parts to answer; default all three.

areas.description: For service_areas. "care" (default): health unit and CRAS. "safety": Polícia Militar company, Polícia Civil district and fire (Corpo de Bombeiros) platoon areas. "all": both.

point.description: The point rounded to 4 decimals (about 11 m): the only precision sent to the source.

inside_curitiba.description: False when no Curitiba neighbourhood contains the point (a neighbouring city).

boundary.description: The point touches more than one neighbourhood; `bairro` is the first by name.

version.description: Version date of the zoning map as published (data_versao), e.g. "2020-08".

layer.description: 41 (zoning with Decree 297/2026 areas) or 36 (zoning, Lei 15.511/2019) when 41 has nothing here.

zoning.description: Zones containing the point (distinct, at most 5; two on a boundary); null when the layer could not be read or was not asked (outside Curitiba).

nearest_street.description: Nearest street line within 100 m, straight-line distance; null when none.

partial.description: True when the zoning or street layer could not be read; that field is then null.

checked_at.description: When the server read the oldest layer used for this part (cached for up to 6 hours).

place.description: Bairro, regional, zoning and nearest street; null when not in `include` or not read (then `partial` is true and `notes` says why).

inside_curitiba.description: True when the first layer asked (health unit area, or Polícia Militar company for `safety`) or a Curitiba neighbourhood contains the point; false otherwise (a neighbouring city), and then no other layer is asked.

name.description: Health unit (unidade de saúde) whose area covers the point, e.g. "US MÃE CURITIBANA".

reference_date.description: The area's reference date as published (`data`), e.g. "março/2022" or "MAR-2019"; the area may have changed since.

source_agency.description: Agency named by the area (`fonte`), e.g. "SMS-PMC" or "Fundação de Ação Social - FAS".

approximate.description: `geometriaaproximada` as published: true when the area's outline is marked approximate; null when unset.

health_units.description: `care`: health unit areas containing the point (distinct, by name, at most 3). Empty: none covers the point. Null: not read (its group not asked, or its layer not read; see `partial`).

name.description: CRAS whose territory covers the point, e.g. "MATRIZ".

reference_date.description: The area's reference date as published (`data`), e.g. "março/2022" or "MAR-2019"; the area may have changed since.

source_agency.description: Agency named by the area (`fonte`), e.g. "SMS-PMC" or "Fundação de Ação Social - FAS".

approximate.description: `geometriaaproximada` as published: true when the area's outline is marked approximate; null when unset.

cras.description: `care`: CRAS territories containing the point (distinct, by name, at most 3). Empty: none covers the point. Null: not read (its group not asked, its layer not asked outside Curitiba, or not read; see `partial`).

source_agency.description: Agency named by the area (`fonte`), e.g. "SMS-PMC" or "Fundação de Ação Social - FAS".

police_military.description: `safety`: Polícia Militar company areas containing the point (at most 3). Empty: none covers the point. Null: not read (its group not asked, or its layer not read; see `partial`).

district.description: Police district as published (`nm_distrito`), e.g. "3º Distrito Policial".

source_agency.description: Agency named by the area (`fonte`), e.g. "SMS-PMC" or "Fundação de Ação Social - FAS".

police_civil.description: `safety`: Polícia Civil district areas containing the point (at most 3). Empty: none covers the point. Null: not read (its group not asked, its layer not asked outside Curitiba, or not read; see `partial`).

platoon.description: Fire platoon as published (`pelotao`), e.g. "Pelotão de Bombeiro Central".

battalion.description: `batalhao`, e.g. "1° Batalhão de Bombeiro Militar - Curitiba".

source_agency.description: Agency named by the area (`fonte`), e.g. "SMS-PMC" or "Fundação de Ação Social - FAS".

fire.description: `safety`: fire platoon areas containing the point (at most 3). Empty: none covers the point. Null: not read (its group not asked, its layer not asked outside Curitiba, or not read; see `partial`).

partial.description: True when a layer of a group asked could not be read; its list is then null.

checked_at.description: When the server read the oldest layer used for this part (cached for up to 6 hours).

service_areas.description: Areas that cover the point; null when not in `include` or not read (then `partial` is true and `notes` says why).

inside_curitiba.description: False when no Curitiba census sector contains the point.

density_per_km2.description: Residents per km² as published (dens_pop_km2), 1 decimal.

mean_income_brl.description: Mean monthly nominal income (R$) of the household heads with income, in occupied permanent private households (renda_media); null when IBGE did not publish it.

sector.description: The sector containing the point; null when withheld or none.

sector_withheld.description: True when the sector has fewer than 20 occupied private households: its figures are not given.

name.description: Neighbourhood as IBGE spells it (nm_bairro), e.g. "Botiatuvinha".

sectors.description: Sectors counted: those with 20 or more households.

area_km2.description: Sum of the counted sectors' areas (withheld sectors left out), 2 decimals.

density_per_km2.description: persons / area_km2 of the counted sectors, 1 decimal.

neighbourhood.description: Totals of the neighbourhood's sectors with 20 or more households, so a withheld sector cannot be subtracted back (no income: a mean of sector means is not the neighbourhood's); null when not read or none.

partial.description: True when the neighbourhood totals could not be read; `neighbourhood` is then null.

checked_at.description: When the server read the oldest layer used for this part (cached for up to 6 hours).

census.description: IBGE 2022 census sector and neighbourhood; null when not in `include` or not read (then `partial` is true and `notes` says why).

partial.description: True when a part, or a layer inside one, was not read: the call's time budget ran out (requests to the host are 5 s apart) or the host failed. Call again: the layers already read are cached.

notes.description: Caveats of the answer, one per part, then why a part was not read.

category.description: One fixed category of public place: park (OSM leisure=park), library (OSM amenity=library), school (OSM amenity=school), community_centre (OSM amenity=community_centre), townhall (OSM amenity=townhall), bus_station (OSM amenity=bus_station), marketplace (OSM amenity=marketplace), police (OSM amenity=police), fire_station (OSM amenity=fire_station). community_centre and townhall include Ruas da Cidadania where OSM tags them so. police and fire_station come from a list bundled once from OSM (no network call).

name.description: Words that must all appear in the place name (accents and case ignored).

address.description: OSM addr:* tags as tagged; null when not tagged.

opening_hours.description: OSM opening_hours as tagged (OSM syntax), or null.

website.description: Only an http(s) link without credentials, else null.

bundled.description: True for police and fire_station: a list taken once from OSM, no network call.

checked_at.description: Day the bundled list was taken (YYYY-MM-DD); null for live categories.

osm_data_as_of.description: Overpass osm3s.timestamp_osm_base: how fresh the OSM copy is.

query.description: Text in the returned object or the body name, accents and case ignored (e.g. 'medicamentos', 'FAS'). Sent to PNCP's site search, which matches whole words ('merenda', not 'merend'); only results whose returned object or body name contain it are kept.

from.description: First publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days before 'to'.

to.description: Last publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today (Brasília). Range ≤ 365 days.

modality.description: PNCP modality code (PNCP needs exactly one per query): 1 Leilão - Eletrônico, 2 Diálogo Competitivo, 3 Concurso, 4 Concorrência - Eletrônica, 5 Concorrência - Presencial, 6 Pregão - Eletrônico, 7 Pregão - Presencial, 8 Dispensa, 9 Inexigibilidade, 10 Manifestação de Interesse, 11 Pré-qualificação, 12 Credenciamento, 13 Leilão - Presencial, 14 Inaplicabilidade da Licitação, 15 Chamada pública, 16 Concorrência – Eletrônica Internacional, 17 Concorrência – Presencial Internacional, 18 Pregão – Eletrônico Internacional, 19 Pregão – Presencial Internacional, 20 Diálogo Competitivo Internacional. Default 6.

page.description: Upstream page to start from; pass the previous result's next_page (with page_source) to continue.

page_source.description: Which pages 'page' counts: pass the previous result's next_page_source. Default: 'search' with query, 'scan' without. 'scan' with query continues the fallback page scan; 'search' needs query.

skip.description: Matches to skip on the first scanned page; pass the previous result's next_skip to continue.

next_page_source.description: Which pages next_page counts (the site search or the Consulta page scan); pass it back as page_source.

discarded.description: Records of a listed body dropped because a required field was missing or malformed.

station.description: A station code (e.g. "65010000", leading zeros optional) or text matched against the station name, river and municipality, accents and case ignored (e.g. "iguacu", "fazendinha", "araucaria").

near.description: Order stations by distance from this position (decimal degrees). Default: Curitiba centre.

more_matches.description: Matching stations not read in this call (at most 3 per call; first those a source failure, the host gate or the time budget left out).

partial.description: true when some picked stations were not read: the 20 s time budget ran out, the source was limiting requests (rate_limited), the source refused this server (HTTP 401/403 or a CAPTCHA; not asked again for 10 minutes), or the source failed (for example HTTP 5xx, a timeout or a network error; not asked again for up to about 1 minute), after at least one station was read or found in the cache; the stations read are returned.

distance_km.description: Straight-line distance from `near` (or Curitiba centre), in km.

status.description: no_recent_data: the station sent nothing since yesterday 00:00 (Curitiba time). unavailable: its answer could not be read (malformed XML content; that station is not asked again for 60 s). In both cases the values are null.

reading_time.description: Time of the latest reading, Curitiba time (ISO 8601, -03:00).

stale.description: true when the latest reading is older than 2 hours; null without a reading.

level_cm.description: River level (Nivel) of the latest reading, in cm.

flow_m3s.description: Flow (Vazao) of the latest reading, in m³/s.

rain_mm.description: Rain (Chuva) of the latest reading (one 15-minute interval), in mm.

rain_1h_mm.description: Sum of the rain values in the hour ending at the latest reading; null when none. A lower bound when readings are missing.

rain_24h_mm.description: Sum of the rain values in the 24 hours ending at the latest reading; null when none or when that window starts before yesterday 00:00. A lower bound when readings are missing.

checked_at.description: When this server read the station (cached up to 15 minutes); null when unavailable.

quality.description: Checks on the readings of the 24 h ending at the latest one (values are never changed). suspect: a check fired; treat the values with caution. ok: no check fired, which does not prove a value is right. unknown: no reading, or too few to check. Separate from `stale`.

quality_reasons.description: out_of_range: negative level, flow or rain, or over 150 mm of rain in one reading. level_spike: a level jump over 100 cm in 15 minutes that came back within an hour. level_jump_unconfirmed: such a jump in the last hour, not back yet. level_stuck: level identical for 6 h or more while 10 mm or more of rain fell. too_few_readings: under 8 readings in the 24 h (quality unknown).

checked_at.description: The oldest read time among the returned stations.

topic.description: rates: CBS, IBS UF (PR) and IBS municipal (Curitiba) reference rates on the date. nbs / ncm / class_trib: find a service code (NBS), product code (NCM) or tax classification (cClassTrib) by code or words. nfse: fixed note on NFS-e in Curitiba (no network).

query.description: Required for nbs, ncm and class_trib: a code (digits; dots and dashes allowed) or words of the description.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, 2026-01-01 to 2099-12-31; default today in Curitiba. From 2027-01-01 the Receita serves simulated values (simulated: true).

limit.description: Lookup topics: at most this many items (1–25).

disclaimer.const: API piloto da Receita Federal; não é orientação fiscal; confirme com o contador

simulated.description: true: values simulated by the Receita (its header, or a date from 2027-01-01); null for topic nfse.

query.description: Words to find in the name, section or number (e.g. 'defesa civil', 'samu'); accents and case are ignored, every word must match.

text.description: Words to find in the unit name, address (which ends with the neighbourhood) or regional; accents and case are ignored, every word must match.

vaccine.description: Words to find in one vaccine line as published (e.g. "covid 12 anos", "zero a 11"); accents and case are ignored, every word must match.

near.description: Order by straight-line distance from this position (decimal degrees); sites without coordinates are left out.

skipped_units.description: Units on the page that did not fit the known structure and were left out.

hours.description: Opening hours lines as published, e.g. "Horário (segunda a sexta) : Das 7h às 19h".

vaccines.description: Vaccine lines as published, e.g. "Vacinas (12 anos ou mais)".

distance_m.description: Straight-line distance from `near`, in metres; null without `near`.

checked_at.description: When the server read the page (it is cached for up to 6 hours).

listed_in.description: INMET's lists this warning is in; a warning can be in both.

start.description: As published by INMET ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm", no time zone given).

end.description: As published by INMET ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm", no time zone given).

days.description: Number of forecast days (1–5), from the first day INMET publishes (today when checked).
